title: Additional client contact
purpose: Add or update a person at this client besides its primary contact. This record does not create a portal account.
summary: A person at this client besides the primary contact, such as a report recipient, sampler or billing contact.

tasks.title: Add a person
steps: Enter the [[Name]] and at least an [[Email]] or a [[Phone]].
Choose a [[Role]] and tick [[Receives reports]] if they should get reports, then save.

tasks.title: Record that someone has left
steps: Clear [[Is active]], give the [[Reason]] and save. Their record and history stay.

good_to_know: A contact is not a portal account and grants no access. The role is only a label.
Receives reports is information only. Nothing is emailed.
Deactivate people who have left rather than deleting them.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required contact name, up to 160 characters.

items.label: Role
items.description: Optional list: Not recorded, Report recipient, Billing / accounts payable, Sampler, Project lead, Regulatory contact or Other…. Other… reveals a text box (Describe); the text you type, up to 80 characters, is stored. A role recorded before the list existed shows as Other with its text. The role is a label; it grants no access.

items.label: Email
items.description: Optional valid email; at least one of Email and Phone is required.

items.label: Phone
items.description: Optional contact number, up to 40 characters; required when no email is supplied.

items.label: Receives reports
items.description: Initially unchecked. Records who the client wants reports sent to; information only, nothing is emailed.

items.label: Is active
items.description: Edit only; new contacts start active. Deactivate someone who has left instead of deleting their record.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Edit only and required for changes. The explanation and prior values are retained in history.

sections.title: Actions and history
paragraphs: Name, role, email and phone are trimmed. An unchanged edit is refused. Concurrent edits are refused with Contact changed; reload and review current details before resubmitting. Field and form errors leave submitted text on the form.

items.label: Add contact / Save changes
items.description: Project managers and administrators save under the client shown in the breadcrumb and return to that client. A contact cannot be edited through a different client’s URL.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the client without saving.

items.label: History
items.description: Existing contact events appear oldest first, each with a readable title such as Client contact added or Client contact updated, and with the actor, timestamp and reason.
